_comment: Code-scanning alerts dismissed by .github/workflows/code-scanning.yml (contrib/secops/code-scanning-triage.py). One entry per tool + rule + path glob: reason is one of 'false positive', 'won't fix', 'used in tests'; comment is the argument a reviewer can check (280 characters reach GitHub). An optional "step" (a workflow step name or a list) narrows an entry to the alerts on that step. A real finding is fixed in code, never listed here.

dismissals.comment: node/devnet jobs run only on workflow_dispatch (write access). 'Resolve the node branch' admits only a branch or tag of the node repo or a SHA the compare API finds on one of its line branches; fork commits are refused. CodeQL matches the output name 'sha'.

The checkout is the node repo (boyfromcave/ycash-dd or ycash6) at a ref 'Resolve the node branch' admits: its own branch or tag, or a SHA on one of its line branches (compare API). No PR head or fork commit. Dispatch only, write access. CodeQL matches the name 'sha'.

dismissals.step: Check out ycash6's yellowback-attest at the pinned commit
dismissals.comment: Checks out boyfromcave/ycash6 at the commit check-version.sh --remote proved a ycash6 tag names (git ls-remote): the pinned node release, or a dispatch override verified the same way. Tag push or dispatch only (write access); no PR head, no fork; no cache in the job.

step: Build the wallet and package it with the node (build.sh --package)
dismissals.comment: The build job restores and saves no cache. The ycash6 code it builds (yellowback-attest) is at a commit a ycash6 tag names, proved by check-version.sh --remote; tag push or dispatch only (write access), never a PR head or fork commit. CodeQL matches the output name.
